content.text:
I've opened PR #371, which moves pi-action from v2.4.0 to v2.5.1. Branch protection on `main` rejected a direct push, so the change is waiting for review there. Nothing has run on the new version yet.

**What changed** (only `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`):
- `cv/pi-action` is pinned to the v2.5.1 commit, `0c28cb8965aaef821b2dccfa23ebd20e1ca8b002`.
- I also moved the pit version the workflow loads from v0.36.0 to v0.36.3, which you didn't ask for. pi-action 2.5.0 gives extensions a way to resize images, and pit has only used it for `workspace.viewImage` since 0.36.2 (#365). If you'd rather change one thing at a time, put that line back to v0.36.0.

**Changes in how runs behave, from pi-action 2.5.0:**
- **Thinking is on now.** Runs default to thinking level `medium`, where before it was `off`, so they may use more tokens and take longer. To keep the old behavior, set `thinking_level: off`.
- **Bigger system prompt.** The system prompt now includes pi's base sections, `AGENTS.md`, and the skills in `.pi/skills`, which are allowed because the workflow sets `trust_project: true`. Existing threads get one system prompt update on their next run, which causes one miss of the prompt cache.
- **No run inside a run** (from 2.5.1). If the agent starts pi-action from inside a run, that second run now stops immediately.

The PR says "Refs #370" rather than closing the issue. That way #370 stays open until a run on the new version has worked.
